title: Multitools and more
description: It's a mod with multitools, new dimensions, and a bit more. It's my first mod.
body:
# Temu Multitools

Temu Multitools is a vanilla-friendly content expansion mod focused on multitools, exploration, dimensions, and custom world generation.

The mod expands Minecraft survival by adding powerful multitools, new dimensions, custom biomes, and additional gameplay content while preserving the classic vanilla Minecraft experience and progression style.

---

# Features

## Multitools

Temu Multitools adds several multitool tiers that combine the functionality of multiple vanilla tools into a single item.

Available multitools:

* Wooden Multitool
* Stone Multitool
* Iron Multitool
* Copper Multitool
* Diamond Multitool
* Netherite Multitool

Each multitool has different durability, mining speed, efficiency, and attack strength based on its material tier.

Multitools help reduce inventory clutter by allowing players to carry a single tool for mining, digging, chopping, and general survival tasks.

---

## Temu Work Block

The mod adds a custom villager workstation called the **Temu Work Block**.

Villagers can use this workstation to become **Temu Villagers**. Temu Villagers offer unique trades and sell **Fake Multitools**, providing players with an alternative way to obtain multitools through trading.

The Temu Work Block expands village gameplay while fitting naturally into Minecraft's vanilla-style progression system.

---

# New Dimensions

Explore three custom dimensions with unique environments and exploration opportunities.

### Dia Dimension

A resource-rich dimension inspired by diamonds and valuable ores. Explore dangerous terrain, discover valuable resources, and venture into a world designed for exploration and progression.

### Cloud Dimension

A floating world high above the clouds featuring open skies, floating islands, and unique landscapes. Travel between floating landmasses and experience a completely different style of exploration.

### Mysterious Dimension

A strange and mysterious realm filled with unusual terrain, unexpected discoveries, and unexplored locations waiting to be found.

---

# Custom Biomes

Temu Multitools adds multiple custom biomes to improve exploration and make world generation more diverse.

These biomes feature unique terrain, atmosphere, and landscapes while blending naturally with vanilla Minecraft world generation. Players can discover new environments during normal exploration without disrupting the vanilla experience.

---

# Why Download Temu Multitools?

* Combines multiple tools into one convenient multitool
* Adds three new dimensions to explore
* Includes custom biomes and world generation
* Introduces the Temu Villager and Temu Work Block
* Offers unique Fake Multitool trading mechanics
* Reduces inventory management
* Enhances survival and exploration gameplay
* Maintains a vanilla-friendly progression system

---

# Compatibility

* Minecraft Version: 1.21.8/1.21.1/26.1.2
* Supported Loaders: (Forge) / NeoForge
* Environment: Client and Server
